# Welcome to Inkflit

A small place to capture a thought. You can edit or delete these guide notes.
Press ⌘⇧F to search all current notes.

## Notes and shortcuts
⌘N creates a note. Use `⌘[` for the previous note and `⌘]` for the next, or use the arrows above. ⌘1 returns to the newest note.
⌘D deletes the current note after confirmation; you can restore it from Settings → Backups → Trash.
Control + Option + Space shows or hides the window by default. Open Settings with ⌘, to change it.

## Writing
Inkflit supports Markdown: # headings, **bold**, lists and - [ ] tasks. A line starting with // is a note comment.
In NORMAL mode press i to insert; Esc returns to NORMAL, and Esc again hides the window. Use u to undo and Control + R to redo.

In INSERT mode, type / on an empty line to add a feature block. A note can contain several different blocks. Read the next notes for examples.

# Lists and calculations

// Click the checkboxes or type /x at the end of an item.
:::quicknote list
Try a checklist
  A child item
[x] Finished item
:::end

Use Tab / Shift-Tab to indent or outdent. The first item stays at the root; an item can be at most one level deeper than the one above it.

// Expressions ending in = are evaluated. Variables stay inside this block.
:::quicknote math
price: 80
price * 2 =
10 km to mi =
:::end

Select a block header or press ⌘K inside a block to change its type, convert it to text or delete it. ⌘⇧D deletes the current block. ⌘O / ⌘⇧O adds text below / above it.

# Sum, average and count

// A block only calculates its own content. Lines beginning with // are ignored.
:::quicknote sum
Coffee 12
Lunch 28
:::end

:::quicknote avg
10
20
30
:::end

:::quicknote count
A short item
Another item
:::end

Try changing the values and watch the result update. In a non-code block, pressing Return on its last blank line exits the block.
